decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is distant from the maritime core and has no reported results, but it was launched recently and committed publicly, so management will likely treat weak results as start-up effects and persist one more year.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds on the firm's seafarer network and crewing centres and fits the integrated maritime direction, so commitment remains strong.
The Smart Academy has its own page, a growing network of six partner institutions and a central role in the training offer, which makes it a visible, invested and strategically central commitment.

FuelEU monitoring and compliance services are tied to regulation, delivered a reported success by meeting the deadline for all vessels, and are central to the announced environmental performance direction.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL software and supports the digitalisation and compliance strategy, so the sunk development investment and strategic fit favour keeping it.
The FuelEU cost simulator is part of the same integrated compliance package within PAL and is publicly announced, so management will persist despite limited evidence of results.
